summary: A quick overview of what is visible to whom.

blocks.text: Learn more in [Tasks](tasks#who-sees), [Wishlist](wishlist#surprise), [Finance](finance#accounts), [Health](health#people-access) and the [Administrator guide](admin#permissions).

sections.title: What None, View and Edit mean

items: **None**: the part of the app is not shown at all.
**View**: you can read, but not add or change anything.
**Edit**: you can read, add and change.

blocks.text: Not sure what you can do? Open a part of the app. If you can only view it, a short message at the top says so.
